worldcombat.skill.sandattack.summary: Kicks a short fan of grit from the ground toward one direction, blinding every foe caught in the wedge: their accuracy drops and their blows weaken. The range is very short, but the grit takes the colour of the ground underfoot.
worldcombat.skill.sandattack.use.0: Blind a whole line of foes at point-blank
worldcombat.skill.sandattack.use.1: Set up a melee or a retreat
worldcombat.skill.sandattack.use.2: Blind a whole corridor on sand or mud
worldcombat.skill.sandattack.description: A sanded target strikes weaker, and a Pokemon also loses %1$s accuracy stage(s), for %2$s.
Centred on the user toward the target, the fan runs %1$s blocks long with a %2$s degree opening and throws about %3$s grains; up to 4 foes are blinded at once.

Scraping the ground takes %1$s with a %2$s cooldown. The grit takes its colour from the block underfoot: sand yellow, gravel grey, mud brown. The fan points one way only, so stepping aside or behind cover avoids it.
worldcombat.skill.sandattack.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
Coarse: angle x1.35 and blind duration x1.3, but the fan is 0.8 blocks shorter and the wind-up 3 ticks longer; Fine: angle x0.85 and duration x0.8, but the fan reaches 0.8 blocks further, winds up 2 ticks faster and cools down sooner.
The companion only considers sand attack while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller keeps it for point-blank work, larger chases out.
It holds the move until this many visible enemies stand in the fan; set 1 to throw at any sighting, higher to wait for a line.
When on, the companion may leave its post to throw sand under a Hold order.
